name: CyberAv3ngers
akas: IRGC-affiliated per public reporting cited by OpenAI; publicly linked to PLC compromise at the Municipal Water Authority of Aliquippa, PA (Nov 2023) and a water-service disruption in County Mayo, Ireland (Dec 2023)
brief: OpenAI banned ChatGPT accounts assessed, per a credible-source tip, to belong to CyberAv3ngers. Interactions included listing commonly used industrial routers in Jordan; requesting default credentials for a Tridium Niagara device and a Hirschmann RS-Series industrial router; researching recently disclosed CrushFTP and Cisco Integrated Management Controller vulnerabilities plus older Asterisk VoIP flaws; and asking how to obfuscate VBA/Excel macro code (supplying code for the model to obfuscate). Request details suggested interest in/targeting of Jordan and Central Europe. OpenAI: "we believe that these interactions did not provide CyberAv3ngers with any novel capability, resource, or information, and only offered limited, incremental capabilities that are already achievable with publicly available, non-AI powered tools." *Backfill note: discovered this cycle via a secondary source that misdated this report as "September 2026"; it is actually OpenAI's October 2024 "Influence and cyber operations: an update" report, a genuine pre-existing gap in the tracker, not new October 2026 reporting.* OpenAI
activity: Unknown (ChatGPT interactions undated in the report; the group's own prior physical intrusions were Nov–Dec 2023, a distinct window from the ChatGPT-use activity)
